balls.text: Vijay makes room and smashes the ball towards long on where Warner fields and fires the throw back quickly, he just misses at the bowler's end and Yadav lets the ball go through to the keeper, Ojha collects and breaks the stumps to run out Vijay
driven on the front foot to long on, impressive full and straight stuff
full and straight, Vijay makes room by moving towards leg and square drives through point
Bravo stays back and hits the ball hard along the ground to long off
a good ball, Bravo couldn't get under it but he could sprint back for the second after driving to long off
in the blockhole, Vijay taps the ball to point to give Bravo the strike
again! This time over extra cover, Bravo gets under a full ball and drives with so much power, carting it high and far. 25 runs off that over
full and wide outside off stump, Bravo is already on leg stump so he has plenty of room to free his arms and swing hard, he launches the ball into the fans cheering wildly beyond the cover boundary
can't bowl there with fine leg in the circle, 147 kph but on the hips, Bravo gets inside the line and glances it to the fine leg boundary
he's carved that with one hand to the boundary! Bravo moved towards leg to make room, arched his back and then cut loose, flaying his bat at a slower ball to slash it to the third man boundary
Bravo lays into the cover drive, lunging forward and drilling the ball hard
he's lucky that did not go for four, it was a full toss outside leg stump and Vijay missed the glance. Ojha did not collect cleanly
nearly in the blockhole again, flicked towards square leg, where Russell fields
played off the pads to midwicket
short of a length outside off stump, Bravo stays back, stands tall, opens the face and steers the ball fine enough to beat third man running to his left. He just used the pace of the bowler
in the blockhole once again, Vijay stays back and plays towards extra cover
the fast ball in the blockhole outside off, Vijay tries to make room to play through point but is beaten
nudged off the front foot towards long on

that is a ripper of a catch! Albie swung hard at a good length ball angling across him from over the wicket, so hard. He got a thick outside edge that was flying to the third man boundary before Ojha dived to his left and stuck out his glove to catch it at full stretch. He had so little reaction time
this time he does hit down the ground, waiting in his crease to blast the length ball past the bowler, that was hit too hard for long-off to save
edged for four! Vijay tried to hit down the ground and gets an outside edge past the keeper

he gets to his century off 51 balls by flicking the ball off his pads behind square. This is his first fifty-plus score this season. His celebration is emotional, takes off his helmet and drops it, drops his bat too, and raises his hands

caught at deep midwicket! Negi comes running in from the boundary and bends to catch the ball at shin-height while on the move. Good effort. Dhoni had pulled the length ball but didn't time it well enough
too short and Dhoni has blitzed it, swivelling and pulling with oodles of power to the backward square leg boundary
length ball and Dhoni pulls it towards cow corner, Warner sprints a long way to his right from long-on and dives to make the save
Dhoni gets hurried by a short of a length ball and he too fails to connect with the whip through square leg. Russell conceded only 5 that over
good length on middle and leg, Vijay misses the flick and gets a leg bye on the leg side
short of a length and straight, Vijay sways out of the way and lets it go
Vijay moves to 99 by swinging a full ball through midwicket
a slower ball on a good length, Vijay defends back to the bowler
short of a length and straight, pulled off the back foot to midwicket

it's falling apart for Daredevils, Warner's dropped a catch. Dhoni whipped out the helicopter again, but this time the elevation wasn't high enough. Warner ran to his right from long-on, got to the catch in time, but dropped it. He was trying to catch it on the slide, so the ball went straight through his hands
Vijay tries to glance the ball off his pads but misses, that was down leg side
hit hard towards long on for a single

the helicopter's arrived early today! Dhoni steps out and whips hard with his wrists, blazing the ball over the leaping Warner at long-on. Had it been Morkel doing the leaping, he might have reached it
that's just too short, I'm surprised Dhoni did not launch it into the stands, his pull just cleared the midwicket boundary
played towards long on for a single this time
Sunny's gone the distance, Vijay skipped out of his crease, got to the pitch of the ball, and smashed it over wide long-on
dabbed off the back foot towards point
stays in his crease and drives the ball through cover
that is a good catch! Raina smashed the ball flat and straight to Negi, who stayed well balanced as he caught the ball with both hands to his right. It was hit hard
Raina lunges forward, gets under a full ball and lofts straight, hitting the ball high and just far enough over long on
driven off the front foot towards cover
short ball and Raina's pulled it into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary, Warner didn't seem to pick it up and so did not chase
Raina tries to pull from outside off but gets the toe end of the bat on the ball, which goes towards third man. The umpire signals for the time out.
dabbed to third man for a single
shot! Vijay backs away towards leg stump and drives a length ball flat over extra cover, Russell is disappointed that the fielder at long off did not try and save it

Sehwag's mis-judged the catch, he was slow to run back and in the end the ball fell just over his head at midwicket. That's a drop. Raina tried to pull again but the ball was slower and he top-edged it towards Sehwag.
poor ball, too short on this pitch, Raina swivels and pulls to the backward square leg boundary
slower ball on off stump, Vijay opens the face and steers to point, there could have been at overthrow at the bowler's end had Warner not come running in from the boundary
this time he gets an inside edge towards midwicket, he had come out of his crease and wanted to loft own the ground, he did not get to the pitch of it
driven off the front foot to long off
pushed from the crease towards point
nudged off the front foot through midwicket and he's played it gently enough to get two
pushed off the front foot towards cover
he's hammering everything now, Vijay steps out of his crease and lofts the left-arm spinner cleanly over long off, lovely 88-metre six
pushed towards midwicket for a single
Vijay's on fire, he steps out again, gets to the pitch of the ball, and swings hard, launching the ball over cow corner
terrific placement, Vijay comes forward and whipped the ball off his pads to the wide long on boundary, Sehwag getting some of his own medicine
width outside off stump, slightly short as well, Vijay goes back and cuts hard to the backward point boundary
played towards cover

has that been caught on the deep midwicket boundary? If Taylor's taken it, it's a stunner. It was a long hop, which Vijay pulled flat towards deep midwicket. Taylor was on the edge and he jumped back to catch the ball with his right hand. As he landed though, his foot stepped on the rope. So that's a six. He went on to throw the ball up, step out, and dive forward back into play to catch the ball
on the back foot to a ball which was shorter, keeps a tad low, pushed to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, pushed at it, outside edge to the point region for a single
goes down the pitch, shortens his length, to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, slightly wider, driven to deep cover
goes down the track, full-toss, driven to sweeper for a single
round the stumps, outside off and opened the face of the bat to short third-man for a single
and a four again to bring up his 50, outside the off stump and Vijay has thumped it over extra-cover for a boundary, doing it so easily this man tonight!
on the middle, short of length, tucked away to square-leg for a single
up and over for a four, short of length, Raina opens the face of the bat and gets it over the wicket-keeper, it hit the bat high but still managed to get it over for four
round the stumps, angling in, pitched up, pushed to mid-off, call of no by one of the batsmen
round the stumps, outside the off stump, wanted to drive at it and misses the outside edge through to the keeper! Almost another first-baller for Raina!

edged and gone, taken by the keeper! Yes, they can get a wicket, it is Aaron, who is brought back, down the track goes Hussey, wants to drive it, gets the outside edge of bat and Ojha takes a simple one
round the stumps, outside the off, pitched up, swept away to deep square-leg for a single
down the pitch, mistimed to the long-on region and they get a single
outside the off stump, wanted to cut again but to the backward point fielder
full-toss, was going down the track and wanted to hit it over long-off, gets only up to long-off for a couple
on the off stump, pushed to the off side, the fielder's there
round the stumps, on the off stump, turning away, wanted to cut but gets an outside edge to backward point
on the off stump, pushed to the off side and they rush off for a single, Hussey was struggling to get in but the throw is nowhere close
pitched right up, on his pads, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
and this time it is Hussey who goes after the bowling, pitched right up and heaved away to wide long-on region for another boundary
goes the track yet again and this time he drives it over to long-off, goes on the bounce to the fielder
shimmy down the pitch and lofted for four over the deep mid-wicket region! Not only was he quick to get there but also picked the gap up well...
outside the off stump, pitched right up, driven to long-off for a single

bouncer again and he has been pulled away for a four over short fine-leg, it surprised the batsman with the pace but he went through with the shot, the fielder was back pedalling but does not get his hand on it, four for Vijay!
mistimed for four, pitched up and he has hoicked it over the leg side, misses the square-leg easily and there is no-one in the deep
gives himself room, angling in and he wants to go over the top, does not get too much elevation and goes on the bounce to the mid-on fielder
short of length, bouncer attempted, Vijay lets it go through to the keeper, he is looking good
outside the off stump, left alone and that is quite wide outside the off stump, and called by the umpire as well
inside out, over the top and for four, it was pitched up and Vijay has given himself some room and sweetly timed over the extra-cover region
outside the off stump, length ball, driven on the up to the covers
on the middle stump, short of length, slower, pushed to the covers
short of length outside the off stump, slower as well, opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
short of length, pushed to the off side to extra cover but not for a run
full-toss on the pads and that is easily flicked away to fine-leg for a four!
short of length, on the back foot, pushed to the leg side

down the track and almost a catch! He wanted to go over mid-on, short of length, but gets bit under it, goes high in the air, the fielder from deep mid-wicket rushes in and dives but misses, Negi the man
outside the off stump, short of length, punched to the covers, almost goes through but a diving stop restricts it to one
ooooh, beauty, on the middle stump, short of length, does not bounce too much, but some movement away and beats the outside edge of the bat
another one on the middle, pitched fuller, he is still on the back foot and pushed to the leg side
on the middle stump, on the back foot, pushed to the point fielder, loud shout of 'Wait!'
short of length, goes on to the back foot, 139.7 km/hr, tucked away to backward square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up and beautifully driven through the covers for a four! Stood up really tall while playing that one
on his pads, tucked away to fine-leg for a single

outside the off stump, pitched up, driven to the covers, Negi had the ball, picked it up and threw it at the non-striker's end, Rao does not back up well and it goes to the fence for four overthrows! Hussey was diving back to get in but even if that had hit, he would have been safe
marginally outside the off stump, on the length, driven on the up but not off the middle of the bat, gets bit of an outside edge through to third-man for a single
another one short of length, pushes Hussey on to his back foot, punches it back to the bowler
outside the off stump, length ball, Hussey drives it on the up but to the short cover fielder and no run
on the middle stump, bit of deviation into the batsman, Hussey is on to his back foot, pushed to the off side but not for runs
fuller this time, outside the off stump, Hussey tries to drive it but gets an outside edge through to third-man for a single
short of length but on his pads, easily flicked away to fine-leg for a single
short of length, quick too, 140.0 km/hr, goes on to the back foot, pushes it to mid-off for a single
just outside the off stump, shortens his length and this time Hussey lets it go through to the wicket-keeper, shoulders arms
on the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, puts his foot out and drives him through the covers for a four!
outside the off stump, moving away, wanted to drive it away on the up, missed the outside edge and the wicket-keeper appealed for it, nothing from the bowler or the umpire
on the off stump, pitched right up, driven to long-off for a single
on the leg stump, pitched up, he was going down the track but was cramped for room, easily pushed away to deep square-leg for a single
short of length, on his pads, goes on to his back foot and pushes it to the leg side for a quick single
round the stumps, pitched right up, driven to long-on for a single this time
down the track once again and this time it is driven through the right of the mid-off fielder and that has rushed away to the fence for another four, two boundaries to begin this virtual semi-final
round the stumps, down the wicket and lofted over mid-off for a four! Exciting start from the Super Kings, positive stroke from Vijay to open his account

Daredevils are all out! Dhoni runs towards the leg side to collect the ball after the batsman had stepped out of his crease and dabbed. He whipped around and hit the stumps at the striker's end direct, catching the batsman just short. The Super Kings have stormed into the finals.
defended on the front foot
Umesh drives on the front foot with a gap between bat and pad, Ashwin pitches outside off stump and spins the offbreak through that gap
Umesh tries to sweep but fails to connect
doesn't read the doosra and gets hit on the pad while trying to play on the leg side
driven off the back foot to long on for a single, Time-out time

he's so far out of his crease that Dhoni could have drunk a glass of water and then stumped young Sunny. He charged down the pitch and swung with all he had, but did not connect against the left-arm spin
nudged off the front foot towards square leg
tries to cut off the back foot but gets beaten
little Negi can hit it! He stepped out of his crease and lofted the ball cleanly through the line over the long on boundary
cut off the back foot towards cover
cut off the back foot in front of point

cut off the back foot towards point and there may be a run out at the bowler's end! The fielder picked up and threw to Ashwin, who collected the ball with his fingertips on the half-volley and broke the stumps. Rao's effort to make his ground was not desperate, just a lame stretch, and so he has to go

Mahela's been bowled after failing to connect with the reverse pull. He got into position early enough and swung hard, trying to pull the ball behind point. He missed and the straighter one clipped the top of middle and leg
steps out of his crease but he isn't to the pitch of the ball this time, taps it to long on
cut off the back foot to short third man
steps out of his crease, gets under the ball, and carts it over the long off boundary with a full swing of the bat
steps out again and drives to long on
Rao steps out and cuts a short flat ball to point
driven through cover where Hussey dives on the boundary to save the four
defended on the front foot

caught, right on the edge of the long-on boundary. It was a full toss and Ojha did not make perfect contact. Vijay judged the catch perfectly, though, and then he tries to dance like Bravo. He can't quite pull it off. Some things are best left to the West Indians. Maybe I was mistaken, looks like he was hobbling with some cramp after jumping back to catch the ball.
shot! Ojha steps out of his crease and lofts the left-armer with the turn over the long off boundary. Clean striking
the slower ball outside off, Mahela is beaten on the cut. Four runs in that over
Ojha tries to pull but the ball is not short enough and he is hit on the pad for a leg bye towards square
Mahela steps out and towards leg to square drive the ball on the up through point
played with soft hands towards point
swivels and pulls towards long leg
Mahela clears his front foot and tries to swing through midwicket, he gets hit on the pad by a full ball
defended on the front foot towards cover
the offbreak nearly bowls Mahela, the ball almost finds the bat pad gap

Bravo's busting a few smooth moves after catching Russell at long-on! Russell tried to slog at Ashwin's flighted ball with a flat bat, unlike Mahela who got to the pitch of the ball. He got a top edge that went straight up, Bravo ran forward and to his left to catch it
tapped towards mid-on for a single
Mahela reaches his half-century by skipping down the track and lofting the ball sweetly over wide long on, enviable timing
Russell wound up and swung across the line extremely hard, Ashwin slowed it up and beat the bat, Russell had swung too early and got hit on the shoulder, he was down on one knee
in the blockhole outside off, driven to deep cover
no one's going to field that, Russell has blasted it flat to the extra cover boundary, the slower ball was full and wide, giving Russell room to free his arms
hit hard off the back foot, but Bravo moves quickly to his left to field it, superb athleticism
dropped, but a tough chance. Mahela stepped out of his crease and mis-hit the ball just over Bravo's head, he jumped too early in his follow through and was off balance
a length ball swung through midwicket
that's too close outside off stump to cut and Mahela gets beaten
that's wide down leg side
played towards long off, where Raina fields
steps out of his crease, Jakati shortens his length, and Mahela plays towards cover
cut off the back foot to deep point
played to long on for a single
Russell slams the ball towards wide long off, where Bravo sprints to his right and intercepts it, throws it quickly back to the bowler as well
left-arm spin from round the wicket, Mahela gets down and sweeps to backward square leg
flicked away to deep square leg for a couple, it was slower on his pads and he manages to get it  to the leg side, somewhat clumsy but two it is
on his pads and flicked away, it seemed to have come quicker on to MJ, who manages to get it over mid-wicket and they get a single to wide long-on
outside edge and drops just short of the third-man fielder, pitched right up outside the off stump, goes for a drive, loops up to third-man but falls in front

bouncer and top edged away over the keeper for a four, it was short alright and he was almost ducking into it, gets a glove on it and while it loops up over the keeper for four, it seems to have hurt Russell on his right thumb

tries to slog it over mid-on and is caught! Outside the off stump and Ross Taylor tries to heave it over mid-wicket but is only able to get it as far as the long-on fielder, where Raina takes a good catch, it was hit hard alright
on the pads, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
way down the leg side, Dhoni has to dive to his right, gets a glove on it but is unable to stop it, they get a wide and are able to come back for the second
leading edge, almost carries back to the bowler, Ashwin gets it on the bounce and is frustrated about something
outside the off stump, top spinner, hits the pad and there is a loud shout from both, the keeper and the bowler, not given
fuller from round the stumps, driven to long-on for a single
round the stumps, on the leg stump and the turn takes it down the leg side for a wide
swept away well, placed excellently and Raina has to run to his right to stop it, and they are able to get back for a couple
immediately dropped short from Ashwin, pulled it away and the fielder at fine-leg, Hilfy dives to stop it, Jadeja tidies up and throws in, Jayawardene had to dive in
reverse swept away and over the point region for a couple, does not get too much in the middle and it is mistimed
six more, slogged it over deep mid-wicket again, it was outside the off stump and bowler flatter and quicker, he quickly moved to his right and heaved it over the in-field for a big six
tries the same shot again, outside the off but fuller and he misses
shot, six, the hockey flick comes into play, shimmies to the off stump, and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a six
short ball from Jakati, quicker too and that has been pulled away in the gap between mid-wicket and long-on for a couple
on the middle stump, he was rocking on to his back foot and wanted to hit it over the field, can get it only to deep mid-wicket
round the stumps, short of length, wants to heave it away immediately, gets it only to long-on
pitched right up to the batsman and drilled away, the covers fielder dives to his right and stops a certain boundary, only a single
slower ball, length ball, wanted to give himself room by going outside the leg stump, the slower ball defeats his shot and it rolls over to the third-man for a single
short ball and he tries to pull it away, gets no timing on it and goes to deep square-leg for a single
fuller on his pads this time, tries to flick it away and gets it only to deep square-leg for a single
pitched up on the off stump and hit over the long-on region for a six, through the line and on the up to bring some cheer for the Delhi fans. I guess.
pitched fuller, on the middle stump, dug out to mid-on for a single
oooh, delicate! opens the face of the bat to a ball outside the off stump, and gets it through third-man for a four, the fielder was squarer there
short ball attempted, outside the off stump, wanted to pull it away, misses hitting the middle of the bat, gets it to mid-wicket for a single
short of length again, cuts it away to third-man for a single
slower one, outside the off stump, wants to cut it away but the slowness of the delivery does not help, straight to point
short of length, goes on to the back foot, opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single
on the middle stump, he wanted to flick it over fine-led, misses his bat, hits the pads but was going down the leg side, appeal was loud, but no effect on the ump
outside the off stump and Taylor has launched it through the covers for a four, good way to get off the mark!
outside the off stump, fuller and driven through the covers...or is it, no it is really fielded well by Jakati, who dives to his left and stops it!

short ball and caught! It was outside the off stump and Sehwag wanted to pull it away, gets it high on the bat and Hussey rushes away to his right from mid-on to take a good catch, two down and in big trouble
fuller, on the pads, almost a yorker-length ball, drills it to short mid-wicket
slower one and he goes for the pull and misses, Sehwag looks a tad frustrated with all those bouncers and he wanted to hit out except that the ball did not arrive
outside the off stump, short of length, opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
on the pads, short of length, he tries to whip it away but misses
down the leg side this time, short of length yet again, and wide called
another bouncer from Hilfenhaus to Sehwag, continues to pepper him with the short ones and he goes under, wide called
bouncer again and he was going for a pull, gets a glove and it lobs up to the right of the square-leg fielder, just eludes the diving man!
short of length, on the back foot, he is on his toes trying to tuck it away, gets a leading edge and it balloons up but very close to the batsman
outside the off stump, pitched up and drilled to mid-off, Vijay, who else is the fielder and he moves to his right and holds on to the ball coming in at bullet-like pace!
short of length, wanted to pull it away, probably a bit of glove through to the keeper, but on the bounce
on the off stump, pitched right up, pushed to the off side and by the time mid-off comes around, they are able to get away for a single
pitched up by Morkel, outside the off stump, slower though and he goes for a drive, straight to Suresh Raina, who misfields and they get a single
on the middle stump, gets his foot out and pushes it to the leg side
chipped it away over deep square-leg for another four! This was half-volleyish on the pads and he has flicked it to deep square-leg for a boundary
pitched up and hit over the extra-cover for a four, that was fuller and outside the off stump and MJ had enough room to hit it over
slower one, on the middle stump, short of length, pushed to the leg side for a single
short from Hilfehaus and MJ has cracked it through mid-wicket for a four, it made a good sound too!
outside the off stump, width for the batsman, cuts it but to the third-man fielder, Warner looks at the bottom of his new bat
short of length, wants to swivel and pull it away, misses the bottom edge and through to the keeper
outside the off stump, short of length, wants to push it on the up but gets it at the bottom of his bat which looks a tad hurt, change of bats for the batsman
on his pads, half volley and it has been flicked away to deep fine-leg for a single
on the middle stump, short of length, Jayawardene was moving to the off stump and jabs at it, hits his pads
